title: A `Core\Metrics` write allocates on every call, even to a series that already exists.
text: `benches/members/core/Metrics/gauge.nvs` counts 8 allocations and about 240 bytes a call with no labels, against a declared `allocations 0`. Three sources are read from the code: `write` renders the call site's `file:line` into a `String` on every call although only a first write or a refusal reads it; `nvs_runtime::metrics::key` builds an owned series key for every lookup; and `Registry::admit` clones the name and the key through `entry` even when both are already present. The same path runs twice per served request through `Registry::request`. Closing it is a borrowed lookup for an existing series and a site rendered only when it is stored, which changes how the registry keys its series and is not a slice.
